body.statement: For a recursive semi-Markovian causal graph \(G\), the Shpitser--Pearl \(\mathrm{ID}\) recursion uses ordinary probability marginalization and C-component \(Q\)-factor recursion. A successful run returns a correct observed-law expression for \(P_{\mathbf x}(\mathbf y)\), while a failed run returns a graph pair containing rooted C-forests that form a hedge witnessing nonidentifiability.
